iconicAnchor.label: The Glitch Moment(um)
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Menkman's foundational account connects glitch art to compression, feedback, signal noise, technical failure, cultural meaning, and the visible specificity of media artifacts.

sources.title: The Glitch Moment(um)
supports: Glitch art operates across glitches, compression, feedback, and other noise artifacts rather than one decorative RGB effect.
The artifact's technical and cultural specificity is central to the practice.

sources.title: The Collapse of PAL
supports: Rosa Menkman's work uses analog signal, compression, glitches, feedback, image bending, and damaged capture hardware as material processes.
The work establishes signal failure and obsolete media behavior as compositional content.
